title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Software Engineering
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
As a Manager, Software Engineering in the Services organization, you will have the opportunity to lead the development of analytics applications that sit atop vast datasets gathered by retail stores, restaurants, banks, and other consumer-focused companies. Innovative product opportunities, modern business questions, and intricate datasets present uniquely challenging problems that we are eager to take on. Mastercard's next-generation platform blends industry-leading analytics, advanced software architecture, and the latest web technologies to face these problems. Our software is required to effectively decipher analytically complex insights from these problems, on which businesses base multi-million-dollar business decisions.
  
  
As a member of the Business Experimentation & Optimization team, you will apply your full-stack development skills to building industry-leading business experimentation software that brings sophisticated analytic techniques to business users around the world. We are rapidly expanding our product offerings and innovating on how we deliver Business Experimentation & Optimization solutions to our clients.
  
  
What is Services organization?
  
  
The Services organization is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. We combine traditional management consulting with our rich data assets and in-house technology to provide our clients with powerful insights and tools to drive fact-based decision-making. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, our services include consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation, and data-driven information and risk management. While specializing in the payments industry, Mastercard Services also works closely with major retailers, airlines, and other enterprises, leveraging data and insights garnered from within and beyond its network.
  
  
We are looking for passionate, talented technologists who share our vision of empowering our customers to make better, fact-based decisions to join us and help shape our team's growth.
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, and a technology innovation lab. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you.
  
  
Role
  
  
As a Part Of Business Experimentation & Optimization, You Will Build Revolutionary Products That Advance How Businesses All Over The World Seize The Most Value From Their Data. As a Manager, Software Engineer Within The Business Experimentation & Optimization Team, You Will
  
  

* Formally supervise, coach, and develop a high-performing development team

* Lead large-scale projects from inception to release
* Lead design of major, complex parts of the platform with high-quality development
* Define state-of-the-art service-oriented software architectures
* Spend 50% of your time on active software development tasks
* Lead planning and scoping features for the team
* Build features used by some of the world's largest organizations to make multi-million dollar decisions
* Critically review the code and guide the team with a focus on improving the code quality
* Play a key role in shaping the direction of engineering processes through working on a small team empowered to organize and run the team as they see fit
* Mentor junior engineers and teammates
* Collaborate across teams with exceptional peers who are passionate about what they do

Ideal
  
  
**All About You**

* Experience managing, coaching, and guiding high-performing software development teams
* Experience with full-stack, data, and cloud technologies such as Databricks, AWS (Data Services + Agentic/ML Services including EMR, Agent Core, Bedrock, etc), .NET/C#, Java, Spring Boot, React, Python, Spark, or similar.
* Experience solving and implementing scalable solutions to solve complex problems
* Experience with AI tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc., and their effective usage in PDLC is highly preferred.
* Proficiency with advanced object-oriented programming, design principles, refactoring, microservice development, and databases
* Strong understanding of web technologies and server-side technologies for developing microservices
* Strong understanding of microservices development and integration of microservices with UI technology
* Passion for analytical/quantitative problem solving
* Motivation, creativity, self-direction, and desire to thrive on small project teams
* Prior experience leading a team or mentoring other engineers, both technically and professionally preferred
* Superior academic record with a degree in Computer Science or related technical field
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. Applicants will be considered and treated without regard to gender, gender identity, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disabled status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: CTO and Co Founder with Investment
description:
**Company Description**
FlocknGo is a community-first platform designed for organizers who run paid group activities and for professionals who join them. It replaces fragmented tools like messaging apps, forms, and spreadsheets with a single platform where organizers manage discovery, bookings, payments, and member engagement. Members can easily find communities that match their interests, book activities in one tap, and receive updates directly on their preferred messaging channels. The platform focuses on building long-term communities rather than just selling tickets, while maintaining strong privacy standards and never sharing phone numbers. FlocknGo is trusted by diverse groups including run clubs, farms, board game organizers, cultural clubs, and professional communities.

**Role Description**
The CTO and Co Founder with Investment role at FlocknGo is location agnostic, but preferably based in the Pune. This role involves leading the technical vision, designing and evolving the platform architecture, and driving end-to-end product development from concept to deployment.

The ideal candidate comes from startup ecosystem with any recent exits and looking for the next challenge of building a startup in the emerging Experience Economy.

The individual will oversee software development processes, coordinate with product and business stakeholders, and ensure that technology decisions align with the company’s community-first strategy. Day-to-day activities include hands-on coding, reviewing technical designs, managing technical roadmaps and sprints, and setting standards for security, scalability, and data privacy. As a co-founder with investment, the person will also participate in strategic planning, help build and mentor the engineering team, and contribute to fundraising and partner discussions.

**Qualifications**

* Strong AI First Software Development skills, including experience with modern web technologies, APIs, and cloud-based platforms.
* Proven ability in Architecture and IT Strategy to design scalable, secure, and privacy-focused systems that support community-centric products.
* Experience in Product Development, from discovery and MVP design through iterations, launches, and user feedback integration.
* Project Management capabilities to plan roadmaps, manage sprints, coordinate cross-functional teams, and deliver on time.
* Background in building or scaling SaaS or marketplace products is highly beneficial.
* Comfort with data-driven decision-making, analytics, and experimentation to improve user experience and platform performance.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a startup environment, take ownership, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. * *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the Position**

As a member of the APAC Solutions team, the
**Senior Energy Market Analyst**
will be responsible for engaging directly with both potential and existing clients to increase sales and deliver technical work. The successful candidate will help drive Energy Exemplar’s growth in markets across the APAC region, by working with the sales team to identifying relevant customer use cases and assist in the development of the go to market strategy. They will seek to understand the customers challenges, identify solutions within the Energy Exemplar product offerings, and articulate the value proposition within the marketplace. The role has a heavy modelling focus.

The successful candidate will be expected to heavily contribute to the building of energy market models for those regions, using Energy Exemplar’s flagship PLEXOS software tool (the role does not require programming/software development). The candidate should have a good understanding of fundamental market price drivers, and ideally have experience in stochastic optimization techniques.

This Senior Energy Market Analyst works in close collaboration with a team of technical subject matter experts. The position is supported by strong training, coaching, and mentoring and provides opportunity for professional growth and career advancement, as well as international travel to customer sites. Successful candidates will have a strong background in modelling, and good customer facing skills; as well as being outgoing, professional, driven, and able to multi-task in a dynamic and often changing environment.

* Lead technical discussions and provide strategic modeling insights to clients.
* Develop and validate complex optimization models tailored to customer needs.
* Guide junior analysts and provide mentorship in modeling best practices.
* Conduct in-depth research on policy impacts, market developments, and emerging technologies.
* Manage project lifecycles, from scoping to delivery, ensuring customer success.
* Collaborate with the product development team to enhance software capabilities.

**Candidate Requirements:**

* Deep knowledge of energy markets & associated economics
* Expertise in model setup, custom configurations, and troubleshooting.
* Experience in scripting, automation, and integrating market datasets.
* Ability to communicate complex subject matter in an easy to understand manner
* Strong commercial awareness
* Top down approach to problem solving – ability to see the big picture
* Strong interpersonal presence and skills - demonstrated ability to build rapport
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Strong listening and presentation skills
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively
* Self-driven, results-orientated with a positive outlook and a focus on quality
* Thorough knowledge of standard Microsoft programs – Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Sense of urgency for goal achievement
* Strong desire for personal and career advancement

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field.
* 5+ years of experience in energy market modeling, forecasting, or optimization.
* Extensive experience in PLEXOS or similar optimization software.
* Strong leadership, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

title: Associate, AI Engineer - Pune - Multiple roles
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Early-career Full Stack Engineer with a focus on AI Engineering to help build next-generation intelligent applications powered by large language models (LLMs). This role sits at the intersection of application development, data engineering, and applied AI—developing scalable systems that leverage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LLM evaluation frameworks, and agent-based architectures.
  
  
You will work closely with platform, data, and product teams to build AI-powered experiences using Azure, Databricks, Postgres, and modern AI/agent frameworks.
  
  
**Major Duties**
AI & Application Development
  
  

* Build end-to-end AI-powered applications (UI + backend services + model orchestration)
* Design and implement RAG pipelines for enterprise knowledge retrieval and grounding
* Develop and deploy LLM-based workflows and agents (multi-step reasoning, tool use, orchestration)
* Integrate models via APIs and hosted platforms (Databricks, Azure AI Foundry, etc.)

LLM Evaluation & Quality
  
  

* Develop LLM evaluation frameworks (accuracy, hallucination detection, relevance, safety)
* Implement automated testing and benchmarking for prompt chains and agents
* Define and monitor LLM performance metrics (precision, recall, grounding fidelity)
* Support experimentation (prompt engineering, model comparisons, fine-tuning readiness)

Data & Backend Engineering
  
  

* Build and optimize data pipelines leveraging Databricks (Spark, Delta)
* Design and query structured and semi-structured datasets using Postgres
* Enable efficient retrieval layers (vector search, embeddings, indexing strategies)
* Support data modeling for AI use cases (knowledge bases, feature stores)

Platform & Agent Development
  
  

* Develop AI agents within Databricks and Azure ecosystems
* Integrate orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar)
* Build reusable services/APIs for agent capabilities (search, summarization, reasoning)

Full Stack Development
  
  

* Contribute to lightweight front-end interfaces for AI applications (React or similar)
* Build backend APIs/services (Python-based frameworks)
* Ensure production readiness (logging, monitoring, scalability, security)

**Experience & Qualification**

* 4+ years of relevant experience in AI engineering, building AI applications, LLM, Python.
* B.E/B.Tech or above degree requried.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: AI Engineer (Autonomous Agents, Voice and MCP)
description:
Company description

SWAB Technologies Private Limited is a Pune-based technology company. We are building an autonomous AI agent that takes voice commands and carries out real business work on its own, such as making calls and running ads.

Role description

We need an experienced AI engineer. This is not a role for freshers or for someone learning on the job. You will build this agent from the ground up. The founder defines what it must do. You decide how to build it, you build it end to end, and you own it for the long term.

* Build an autonomous AI agent that understands voice commands and takes action on its own
* Design and build MCP servers and tool integrations so the agent can operate real business tools
* Enable the agent to act: place and handle phone calls, create and run ad campaigns, and carry out other everyday business tasks
* Build realtime voice pipelines (speech-to-text, LLM, text-to-speech) with low latency, supporting Indian accents and languages
* Build the agent core: planning, tool calling, background task execution, retries, and memory
* Add guardrails so the agent asks for confirmation before irreversible actions such as spending ad budget, payments, or calls, and defend against prompt injection
* Build evaluations, monitoring, and cost and latency controls, so quality is measured and not assumed
* Turn the founder's requirements into working software without needing detailed specifications
* Own the system long term: architecture, reliability, security, and documentation

Qualifications

* Experienced engineer required: significant hands-on experience building and shipping production software, including at least one LLM-based agent or voice product used by real users
* Able to build alone, end to end: backend, APIs, integrations, and deployment, without a large team or detailed specs
* Experience with tool calling, structured outputs, asynchronous jobs, and MCP or similar tool-integration protocols
* Strong in Python or Node.js/TypeScript
* Experience with realtime voice or telephony, or a working project that shows you can learn it quickly
* Understands security for connected business accounts: OAuth, token storage, and least-privilege access
* Based in Pune, or ready to relocate to Pune for this on-site role
* Can show a live product, repository, or demo you built and explain every major decision

Nice to have:

* Experience with advertising platform APIs such as Meta or Google Ads
* Telephony or SIP integration experience
* Indian-language speech recognition or text-to-speech
* Early-stage startup experience as one of the first engineers

What we value:

* Ownership: treats the product as theirs, not as a ticket queue
* Self-driven: takes a clear goal and delivers without being managed step by step
* Long-term commitment: this is a multi-year build, and we want someone who plans to stay
* Direct and honest: tells the founder when an idea will not work, with reasons
* Pragmatic: ships a working version, then improves it with real usage

title: Senior Associate Technology L1_Python
description:
**Job Description**
Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience:**

* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel, building agent orchestration, memory, and tool-use workflows.
* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security & access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.

**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
“AI is evolving fast – join us to work hands-on with big clients, sharpen your skills, and stay future-ready.
  
  
**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

* A high level of interpersonal and presentation skills in English across cultures

* Keen to work as part of a diverse team of international colleagues and in a global inclusive culture
* Python, Pytorch, Git, pandas, sklearn, huggingface
* A minimum of 7 years’ experience with evidence in a related ML field

title: Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer
description:
**# Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer**

* Location:\*\* Pune, Maharashtra
* Work Mode:\*\* Work From Office (WFO)(890)
* Experience:\*\* 8–11 Years
* Salary Budget:\*\* ₹8,00,000–₹18,00,000 per annum (₹8–18 LPA)
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate to 45 Days
* Preferred Candidates:\*\* Local candidates based in Pune

**## Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer to develop, evaluate, test, monitor, and support AI agents and LLM-powered applications across their development and production lifecycle.
  
  
The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Azure Databricks. The role involves agent orchestration, LLM evaluation, experiment lifecycle management, automated testing, observability, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reliability.
  
  
This is a client-facing position involving regular interaction with clients and technical teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with no compromise on communication quality.
  
  
**## Key Responsibilities**
### 1. Agent Development & Orchestration
  
  

* Design, develop, integrate, and maintain AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI-based technologies.
* Build Python-based services, REST APIs, and agent integration components using FastAPI and Pydantic.
* Work with agent orchestration frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and Pydantic-AI, where applicable.
* Support agent workflow development, integration, testing, and production operations.

### 2. LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle
  
  

* Design and implement evaluation frameworks to assess agent quality, response accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance.
* Develop automated evaluation suites using pytest and custom pytest-based evaluations.
* Work with MLflow Evaluation, DeepEval, Ragas, and promptfoo for LLM and agent evaluation.
* Manage experiment execution, evaluation results, test iterations, and quality improvement cycles.
* Identify performance gaps and support continuous improvement of AI agent outputs.

### 3. Agent Observability & Tracing
  
  

* Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability for agent workflows and LLM applications.
* Use OpenTelemetry and OpenInference for telemetry and instrumentation.
* Work with Langfuse and LangSmith to trace agent execution, investigate failures, and analyze application behavior.
* Monitor agent performance and troubleshoot issues across application and integration layers.

### 4. Azure AI Stack
  
  

* Work with Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry for AI application and agent-related workloads.
* Use Azure Monitor and Application Insights for telemetry, application monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
* Support operational monitoring and performance analysis of Azure-hosted AI solutions.

### 5. Azure Databricks & Data Operations
  
  

* Work with Azure Databricks for data processing, SQL-based analysis, and operational workflows.
* Use Unity Catalog for data governance and access management.
* Work with Databricks Workflows/Jobs and SQL Warehouses.
* Support data-related workflows required for AI agent evaluation and operations.

### 6. CI/CD, Testing & Version Control
  
  

* Maintain source code and version control using Git and GitLab.
* Integrate automated tests and evaluation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Support repeatable testing, deployment validation, and release quality checks.
* Troubleshoot build, test, and deployment issues.

### 7. Production Monitoring & Reliability
  
  

* Monitor applications and services using Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Kibana, and alerting platforms.
* Investigate production incidents, analyze logs and telemetry, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Support incident response, issue resolution, performance monitoring, and operational improvements.
* Help improve system reliability, observability, and troubleshooting efficiency.

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure, Containers & Security

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
AI Principle Architect
  
  
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

**All About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Agentic AI Lead - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Lead to drive the design, development and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI solutions across Vodafone’s Corporate AI Portfolio. This role will play a key part in shaping the future of AskHR, Vodafone’s AI-powered HR assistant, by defining agent architectures, advancing multi-agent orchestration across Google Cloud and Microsoft Copilot ecosystems, and creating reusable AI patterns for broader corporate functions. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering leadership, enabling the delivery of secure, scalable and high-quality AI experiences that enhance employee productivity and experience globally.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Agentic AI Engineering
  
  

* Design, develop and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions, ranging from single-agent implementations to complex multi-agent systems
* Implement advanced capabilities including tool and function calling, planning, memory management and agent orchestration
* Apply emerging interoperability standards such as Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Architecture & Knowledge Management
  
  

* Evolve the AskHR AI architecture across Vertex AI Agent Builder, Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine and Gemini, integrating seamlessly with Microsoft Copilot Studio
* Drive improvements in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), grounding quality, chunking strategies, metadata filtering and enterprise knowledge retrieval
* Lead the transition from structured workflow-driven experiences to conversational, agent-led interactions

Quality, Security & Operations
  
  

* Establish robust evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, regression testing and conversation analytics
* Implement observability frameworks, performance monitoring and cost optimisation strategies
* Embed responsible AI principles, privacy-by-design practices, GDPR compliance, prompt-injection protection and enterprise security controls
* Define and implement LLMOps practices and CI/CD processes for prompts, agents and knowledge pipelines

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Mentor and support engineers across multiple squads through code reviews, technical guidance and engineering standards
* Collaborate with architects, conversation designers, product owners and business stakeholders to align technical strategy with business objectives
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and industry developments

Initial Focus Areas
  
  

* Define and secure adoption of a target agentic architecture across HR, Google Cloud, Copilot Studio and SAP platforms
* Accelerate onboarding of HR journeys and knowledge sources through improved ingestion capabilities
* Deliver scalable content ingestion pipelines that significantly reduce onboarding time for new data sources
* Introduce evaluation-led release processes that improve answer quality and user containment rates
* Prototype innovative employee experiences and contribute to the FY28 AI roadmap

Broader Business Impact
  
  

* Develop reusable agentic AI components, accelerators and reference architectures for HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Legal and other corporate domains
* Provide technical leadership across expanding AI portfolios and support the scaling of successful AI solutions throughout the organisation

**Who You Are**
Essential Skills & Experience
  
  

* Significant experience in senior software engineering, machine learning engineering or AI platform development, typically gained over 8+ years
* Proven hands-on experience delivering production-scale generative AI, LLM and agentic AI solutions
* Strong programming expertise in Python, with TypeScript experience considered advantageous
* Deep expertise in either Google Cloud AI technologies (Vertex AI, Agent Builder, ADK, Gemini) or Microsoft AI technologies (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework), alongside working knowledge of the alternative ecosystem
* Strong understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, API design and enterprise integrations
* Experience with cloud-native development, including containers, serverless platforms, infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices
* Expertise in AI evaluation methodologies, observability platforms and production AI monitoring
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and supporting the growth of engineering talent

**Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Experience delivering AI solutions within HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement or other corporate functions
* Knowledge of SAP integrations, including SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BTP
* Experience with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow platforms
* Exposure to multilingual conversational AI solutions, regulated environments and global deployments
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph or CrewAI
* Relevant Google Cloud or Microsoft certifications

**What's In It For You**
Opportunity to define and influence the future state of enterprise agentic AI architecture across a global organisation.Exposure to cutting-edge technologies spanning Google Cloud AI, Microsoft Copilot, Generative AI and multi-agent systems.Collaboration with global AI, architecture, HR and digital transformation teams.Opportunity to drive innovation through proof-of-concepts, experimentation and emerging technology adoption.Ability to create reusable solutions with impact across multiple business functions and global markets.Continuous learning within a rapidly evolving AI and cloud technology landscape.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Advanced multi-agent architecture design and orchestration.Enterprise-scale implementation of Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).AI governance, responsible AI frameworks and secure enterprise AI deployment practices.End-to-end LLMOps, AI observability and automated evaluation methodologies.Integration of AI agents across SAP, Copilot Studio, Google Cloud and enterprise platforms.Scalable knowledge management, RAG optimisation and conversational AI design techniques.Strategic technology planning and AI portfolio leadership.
  
  
**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
At Johnson Controls, you will help build and operate the data platform behind Open Blue, our smart-building platform. In this role, you will build the streaming and lakehouse pipelines that deliver trusted building and energy data to the applications our customers rely on.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer with 3+ years of experience to build, deploy, and maintain pipelines on the OpenBlue Data Platform (OBDP). You will work with Kafka, Flink, Spark, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake alongside senior engineers, and help run them on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with CI/CD and infrastructure as code. This is a hands-on role where you will own well-scoped features end to end, from code to production, and take on more design ownership over time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain Kafka and Flink streaming jobs for ingestion and transformation.
* Develop and maintain Spark jobs for data processing tasks.
* Write unit and integration tests and contribute to CI pipelines.
* Fix production defects and support SIT, UAT, and deployments.
* Deploy and operate data services and jobs on AKS using Helm and Kubernetes operators.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
* Set up monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for pipelines and services (Datadog, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Support routine database and lakehouse operations, including Iceberg table maintenance and PostgreSQL backups and tuning.

**How You Will Do It**

* Own the outcome with accountability by delivering well-tested features and following through on commitments.
* Stay close to work by understanding how the data you build is used downstream.
* Look for root causes, improve continuously, and raise issues with candor.
* Work as one team by partnering with engineers, QA, and product, sharing context, and asking for help early.
* Use clear documentation and disciplined engineering practices to support consistency and handoffs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in software or data engineering.
* Hands-on experience with at least two of Kafka, Flink, Spark, Iceberg, or Snowflake, with working knowledge of or eagerness to learn the rest.
* Proficiency in Java, Scala, or Python, and solid SQL skills.
* Understanding of distributed systems basics such as partitioning, fault tolerance, and idempotency.
* Experience with Git, code review, and agile/Jira workflows.
* Hands-on AI-assisted development with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar, with a critical eye for generated code.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines in a cloud environment.
* Exposure to Trino, PostgreSQL, or TimescaleDB.
* Experience with React and TypeScript.
* Azure experience.
* Production experience with AKS, Helm, or Kubernetes operators for Flink, Spark, or Kafka.
* Experience with time-series or IoT data.
* Experience with Terraform or Bicep and GitOps tools (Flux or Argo CD).
* Azure networking and security basics, including VNets, private endpoints, Key Vault, and Entra ID.

title: Sr. Martech Enterprise System Engineer
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara's Marketing Technology team is scaling its execution capabilities and expanding its AI capabilities to keep pace with a growing go-to-market engine. The systems that power campaign execution, lead lifecycle management, and marketing operations, Workfront, Marketo, and our leads pipeline, require strong, hands-on technical talent to build, maintain, and continuously improve them.
  
  
This IC4 MarTech Engineer role is for a strong technical leader who can transition marketing capabilities from a digital marketing paradigm to an agentic marketing approach by integrating, automating, and configuring new agentic models and solutions across our enterprise capabilities, building reliable integrations, automating marketing workflows, and ensuring lead data flows accurately from capture to CRM handoff.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Build and maintain integrations between Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Workfront, and adjacent MarTech systems, delivering reliable, well-documented solutions.
* Engineer and optimize the lead lifecycle from capture and enrichment through scoring, routing, and CRM handoff, reducing lead leakage and improving data accuracy across the pipeline.
* Develop and maintain automation for campaign operations, asset management workflows in Workfront, and lead management processes in Marketo, replacing manual effort with reliable, auditable automation.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions by working closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Sales Operations to understand needs and deliver working solutions on time.
* Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues across Workfront, Marketo, and the leads pipeline, performing root cause analysis and implementing fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Write clean, maintainable code and configurations following team standards for API design, data handling, error management, and security best practices.
* Contribute to technical documentation by keeping integration maps, data flow diagrams, and runbooks current so the team can operate and onboard efficiently.
* Support peers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration, raising the technical quality of the team's output.
* Monitor platform health and proactively flag performance issues, data anomalies, or integration failures before they impact marketing operations

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, enterprise systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline have recent hands-on work building AI/ML systems
* Solid hands-on experience with Marketo, including program setup, smart list logic, API integrations, lead lifecycle configuration, and data management.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, including workflow configuration, template management, and automation for marketing or creative operations.
* Experience building and maintaining lead management pipelines, including capture, enrichment, deduplication, and scoring.
* Demonstrated production experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector search/embeddings, or recommendation systems — not prototypes, but systems that served real traffic
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and JavaScript/Node.js, with experience owning AWS Lambda data pipelines from design to deployment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and modern ML tooling (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalents)

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
This role is a Bar Raiser hire. The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
* Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
* Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous code reviews, and clear documentation.
* Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
* Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
* Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

**AI Expectations**
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an
**AI Bar Raiser**
, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.
  
  
**Specifically, This Role Is Expected To**

* Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
* Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
* Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
* Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
* Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

Candidates who cannot demonstrate specific, measurable AI impact in prior roles do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness

description:

* Proficiency in scientific writing, documentation, and presentation of research findings.
* Pursuing or completed M.Pharm in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, M.Pharm in Pharmacology, M.Sc in Bioinformatics, or M.Sc in Biotechnology.
* For Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Bioinformatics candidates: knowledge of molecular docking, ligand analysis, protein preparation, and computational drug discovery.
* For Pharmacology/Biotechnology candidates: knowledge of disease mechanisms, ADMET concepts, biological plausibility, and drug safety.
* This is a six-month, remote, unpaid research internship.

* Languages: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, TypeScript/JavaScript

—
  
  
**Experience: 6+yrs**

***Summary**
:*
Makes our simulation products AI-accessible. Our products have rich programmatic surfaces — scripting APIs, file formats, data structures, workflow logic — that are powerful but not designed for AI consumption. This engineer defines the ontology schema that describes those surfaces, builds the knowledge graphs on top of them, and wraps them as structured, typed interfaces that AI agents can discover and invoke.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain ontology schemas describing product capabilities, entities, and relationships
* Build and maintain knowledge graphs over product documentation, APIs, and simulation data
* Build structured tool interfaces exposing product capabilities to AI systems
* Write connectors to product APIs, parsers, and data access layers
* Implement retrieval and context layers over product knowledge
* Work with domain engineers to translate simulation workflows into discrete, callable operations
* Review product ontologies for agentic-readiness across 2–3 products

**Skills We Need**

* Strong Python; experience building and consuming REST APIs
* Familiarity with graph databases and/or ontology/semantic modeling (RDF, OWL, property graphs, or equivalent)
* Experience with at least one agent framework (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar)
* Understanding of how LLMs consume context and call tools
* Comfortable working within unfamiliar or undocumented codebases
* Systems thinker — able to decompose a complex legacy workflow into discrete, callable steps

**Nice To Have**
Vector databases; agent-tool interface development; parsing structured file formats; exposure to CAE/FEA/CFD, surrogate modeling, or physical AI.
  
  
*Deliberately not required:*
Deep simulation domain knowledge — domain engineers provide that. No PhD or ML research background.
  
  
**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: Principal AI Go-to-Market Operations Engineer
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a visionary and highly
**technical AI Go-To-Market (GTM) Engineer**
to sit at the core of our revenue engine. This is not a traditional operations role; it is a hybrid of software engineering, data science, and revenue strategy. You will be responsible for architecting an AI-first GTM ecosystem that bridges the gap between Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success.
  
  
Your goal is to ensure that every individual in our GTM organization and every piece of our technology stack is augmented by Artificial Intelligence. You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* AI Architecture & Custom Integration
* Design, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components.
* Build proprietary internal LLM-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects.
* Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e.g., CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow-up scheduling) across the revenue organization.
* Revenue Ecosystem Optimization
* Partner with RevOps and Marketing Ops to audit the existing tech stack, identifying redundancies where AI can replace high-cost, low-utility third-party vendors.
* Implement predictive modeling to identify high-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real-time "Next Best Action" recommendations.
* Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting.
* Cross-Functional Efficiency
* Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers.
* Consult with Marketing leadership on AI-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
* Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in Marketing/Revenue Operations or GTM Engineering. Deep understanding of the "Leads-to-Revenue" funnel and "Best-in-Class" SaaS ecosystems.
* Ability to write and maintain production integrations — Python, JavaScript, html, or equivalent — connecting AI agents to CRM, MAP, and sequencing tools via APIs. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to ship working code, not just configure no-code tools.
* Deep working knowledge of the modern B2B GTM stack — specifically Salesforce (as CRM and data hub), Clay, Claude, Outreach, Gong or Chorus, etc
* Proven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance.
* Understanding of pipeline math and unit economics: you should be able to work backward from a revenue target to pipeline required, conversion rates by stage, and the specific AI interventions that move each number. If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD," you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel.
* Experience with AI agent orchestration — managing multiple AI agents working different segments or functions simultaneously, resolving conflicts, preventing duplicate outreach, and maintaining data quality in the hub (Salesforce).
* Demonstrated ability to build prompt libraries, training datasets, and refinement workflows for AI agents — treating agent training as a discipline, not a one-time setup.
* Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it — and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. title: QA AIML Consultant
description:
Job Description: AI SDET Engineer
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced AI Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to define and advance quality engineering across web, API, mobile, cloud, and AI-enabled products. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep test automation expertise and can validate both deterministic software and probabilistic AI behavior. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Design, SRE, Security, and Data/ML teams to build quality into the full delivery lifecycle, improve release confidence, and lead the evolution of our testing strategy, tooling, and people.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end quality strategy, including risk-based test planning, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, test matrices, release-readiness criteria, and production validation.
* Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, mobile, integration, and end-to-end testing using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, and pytest.
* Establish maintainable test architecture through modular design, page or screen objects, reusable fixtures, parametrization, test-data management, and appropriate use of BDD, mocking, and stubbing.
* Define API and contract-testing practices for REST and GraphQL services using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate, while promoting effective unit testing and close collaboration with developers.
* Automate test execution, reporting, quality gates, and deployment controls in Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps pipelines.
* Lead performance, load, reliability, resiliency, and security validation using tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling; incorporate chaos testing and OWASP-aligned security checks where appropriate.
* Use logs, traces, and metrics from platforms such as ELK, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger to diagnose failures, reproduce production issues, and drive root-cause analysis.
* Build automated evaluation harnesses and regression suites for machine-learning models, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and agentic workflows.
* Define quality KPIs and service expectations, including escape rate, flaky-test rate, automation effectiveness, mean time to detect, and release quality; communicate trends and corrective actions to stakeholders.
* Create effective defect triage and release-readiness processes, influence product and design decisions, and ensure quality risks are visible and acted upon.
* Protect personal and sensitive information through secure test-data generation, access controls, masking, redaction, retention practices, and GDPR/PII-aware validation.
* Mentor and lead QA and SDET engineers, contribute to hiring and onboarding, and strengthen engineering practices across distributed cross-functional teams.

**Core Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or an SDET role, with evidence of ownership of complex quality initiatives.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript, supported by strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, networking, and operating-system fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience designing test frameworks and maintainable automation architecture with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, pytest, or comparable tools.
* Strong knowledge of test design techniques, risk-based testing, integration and end-to-end strategy, TDD/ATDD practices, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, and test-matrix management.
* Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and service contracts with Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or equivalent tooling; ability to use mocks and stubs to isolate dependencies.
* Practical experience with load and performance testing, reliability or chaos testing, security-testing fundamentals, and OWASP principles.
* Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and working with Git, Docker, basic Kubernetes concepts, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills using logs, distributed traces, metrics, and production observability platforms.
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, influence decisions, and partner effectively with Development, SRE, Product, Design, Security, and Data/ML teams.
* Experience working with quality KPIs and SLAs, supporting release-readiness assessments, and participating in defect triage.
* Working knowledge of GDPR and PII obligations, including secure test-data creation, masking, redaction, and least-privilege access.

AI Testing Expertise
  
  

* Experience testing non-deterministic AI systems and translating product expectations into measurable evaluation criteria, representative datasets, scoring rubrics, statistical thresholds, and repeatable acceptance gates.
* Ability to evaluate large language model quality across correctness, groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, completeness, consistency, latency, token usage, cost, and failure behavior rather than relying on exact-match assertions alone.
* Hands-on understanding of retrieval-augmented generation testing, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval recall and ranking, context relevance, citation accuracy, answer groundedness, and stale or conflicting knowledge.
* Experience building golden datasets and regression suites; curating, labeling, versioning, and reviewing evaluation data while preventing leakage, contamination, duplication, and unrepresentative test coverage.
* Knowledge of adversarial and safety testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect injection, sensitive-data disclosure, insecure tool use, hallucinations, harmful content, toxicity, bias, fairness, and model or agent misuse.
* Ability to test agentic and tool-calling workflows, including multi-step planning, permissions, memory and state, tool selection, retries, timeouts, partial failures, human approvals, and safe recovery.
* Experience validating model, prompt, retrieval, and configuration changes through versioned experiments, reproducible environments, baseline comparisons, confidence intervals, and controlled rollout or canary strategies.
* Understanding of model and data drift, feedback-loop risks, online quality monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, and production signals that detect degradation after release.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation and observability tools such as OpenAI Evals, promptfoo, Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI-specific privacy and security risks, including training-data exposure, model inversion, membership inference, prompt and response logging, retention controls, and safe use of synthetic data.

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience testing mobile, embedded, distributed, event-driven, or highly regulated systems.
* Experience with cloud-native testing on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and with ephemeral test environments managed through Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, model registries, feature stores, data validation, experiment tracking, dataset or artifact versioning, and quality-engineering enablement or open-source tooling.

title: Generative AI Engineering Intern — Venxr
description:
**About Venxr**
Venxr is building AdsGPT, a conversational AI platform that enables brands to plan, execute, and optimise advertising campaigns through natural language.
  
  
We're looking for a curious and hands-on Generative AI Engineering Intern who wants to go beyond basic prompt engineering and learn how to build real-world applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).
  
  
If you've experimented with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AI agents, or memory systems and enjoy figuring out how things work under the hood, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**What You'll Work On**

* Build and improve LLM-powered features for AdsGPT.
* Develop AI workflows that help users plan campaigns, retrieve information, and interact with advertising tools.
* Experiment with AI agents, tool calling, and multi-step reasoning.
* Implement context engineering and memory management to improve the quality of AI responses.
* Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, and external tools.
* Test AI-generated outputs, identify failure cases, and improve reliability.
* Collaborate with the product and engineering teams to turn ideas into working prototypes and product features.

**Tech Stack**

* AI/LLMs: Claude and other frontier models, LLM APIs.
* AI frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
* AI engineering: MCP, LLM orchestration, context engineering, memory management, and tool calling.
* Backend: Python, Django or FastAPI.
* Frontend: React.js.

You don't need to know every technology listed, but you should have a strong interest in AI engineering and practical experience with at least some of these tools.
  
  
**What You'll Explore**
We want you to understand how AI applications work beyond sending prompts to a model.
  
  

* LLM fundamentals: Tokens, context windows, structured outputs, latency, cost, and hallucinations.
* AI orchestration: Building workflows with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks.
* Context engineering: Managing what information the model receives, including retrieval, context selection, and context-window optimisation.
* Memory management: Maintaining conversational history, state, and relevant information across interactions without unbounded context growth.
* AI agents and tool calling: Connecting models to APIs, tools, and external systems.
* MCP: Understanding how models interact with external tools and services through the Model Context Protocol.
* Evaluation and debugging: Testing AI responses, identifying failure modes, and improving system reliability.
* RAG and retrieval: Working with external knowledge sources to generate more relevant responses.

**What We're Looking For**

* 0–1 year of experience in AI engineering, product development internship, or related projects.
* B.Tech in AI/ML or CSE.
* Good foundational knowledge of Python.
* Hands-on experience building at least one GenAI application, AI agent, chatbot, or LLM-powered workflow.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, or equivalent AI frameworks, with an understanding of LLM orchestration, context engineering, memory management, and tool calling.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs and databases.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Willingness to experiment, learn quickly, and explain your technical decisions.

We value practical implementation over certificates. Personal projects, hackathons, academic projects, and open-source contributions count. You should be able to explain what you built, how it works, and what you would improve.
  
  
**Good to Have**

* Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or semantic search.
* Exposure to multi-agent systems and workflow orchestration.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or Ragas.
* Basic React.js or frontend development experience.
* Familiarity with Git, Docker, cloud deployment, or CI/CD.
* Interest in Generative UI, AdTech, or MarTech.

**How We Work**
At Venxr, you'll work on real product challenges alongside the engineering and product teams. You'll have opportunities to experiment with new AI approaches, build prototypes, debug complex workflows, and contribute to features that can make their way into a live product.
  
  
We value curiosity, ownership, thoughtful problem-solving, collaboration, and a willingness to learn from failures.
  
  
We're looking for people who ask questions, take initiative, and enjoy turning ideas into working solutions.
  
  
**Selection Process**

* Technical screening: A 30-minute discussion about your projects, Python fundamentals, and GenAI concepts.
* Take-home assignment: Build a small LLM-powered workflow or agent. AI coding tools are welcome, but you must understand and explain your implementation.
* Technical interview: Walk us through your solution, design decisions, debugging approach, and potential improvements.
* Final round: Technical and managerial discussion.

**How To Apply**
Share your resume along with links to your GitHub, portfolio, or GenAI projects.
  
  
**Note:**
This is a paid internship.Skills: django,ci/cd,langgraph,langchain,cloud infra,nosql,docker,context engineering,system design,rest apis,sql,adtech,mcp,python,memory management,react.js,llm orchestration,tool calling,debugging,generative ui
